airlines.name: United Airlines
airlines.notes: Demo table based on typical delayed-baggage incidental practice. Not legal advice; airline evaluates individual claims.

sources.title: United delayed baggage — incidental expenses (demo corpus)
sources.excerpt: If your bag is delayed, you may be reimbursed for reasonable incidental expenses such as toiletries and essential clothing until the bag is returned. Keep receipts. Coverage is not guaranteed and is subject to review.

sources.title: US DOT — Lost, delayed, or damaged baggage
sources.excerpt: Airlines may reimburse reasonable, verifiable, and actual incidental expenses caused by a baggage delay. Save all receipts. The airline reviews each claim.
